messages:
maria (support): FYI forwarding customer report — after the v3.12 rollout their function invocations to our exec API are failing with schema validation errors. customer attached curl + payload. happening since ~08:20 PDT.

customer-acme: Hey, our production jobs started returning 400s after the update. Example response: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "schema_validation_failed",
    "message": "Unexpected field 'billingHint' in tool args"
  }
}
```

customer-acme: Repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exec \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v3.12","tool":"order_lookup","args":{"order_id":"abc123","billingHint":"enterprise"}}'
```

maria (support): customer says same payload worked yesterday (v3.11). they want ETA / rollback if high impact.

derek (ml-eng): I ran that exact payload against a v3.12 instance and hit the same 400. v3.11 returns 200 with expected tool call.

aj (sre): looking at traffic and errors. global 400 spike on /v1/exec correlated with 08:15 rollout window. no auth 401s, latency is stable. error rate currently ~2.8% of execs across canary hosts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot reports -> 
" + "deploy-bot: rollout rwd-infer-v3.12: started at 2026-03-17T08:15:02Z -> 30% traffic" + "\n\nmaria (support): customer is Enterprise, high priority. they asked for rollback if we can't fix within 1h.

derek (ml-eng): initial root cause: model change to function argument coercion removed permissive key passthrough. previously we tolerated extra fields like billingHint and stripped them; v3.12 now enforces exact schema for tool args when model performs arg validation. that causes our schema validator in the runtime to reject request.

maria (support): can you patch runtime to tolerate extra keys? or do we rollback model?

derek (ml-eng): short term I can add a compatibility shim to strip unknown keys in the exec proxy — small PR, but needs canary deploy. longer term we'll align model arg validation behavior.

aj (sre): ops prefers pause/rollback to limit customer impact while patch is validated. Current error rate would trigger an incident for multiple customers.

maria (support): customer asked for rollback now. I told them we are investigating and will update in 15m.

ops-bot: @ops-pauser invoked: pausing rollout for rwd-infer-v3.12...

deploy-bot: rollout rwd-infer-v3.12 -> PAUSED at 2026-03-17T08:32:14Z

derek (ml-eng): thanks. I'll open PR with compatibility shim and a unit test that repros the failing payload. repro steps:
1) POST payload above to /v1/exec with model rwd-infer-v3.12
2) observe 400 with schema_validation_failed
3) switch model param to rwd-infer-v3.11 -> observe 200 and tool invocation

maria (support): adding notes to ticket and letting customer know rollback paused + engineers working.

aj (sre): creating a short incident to track: INC-20260317-001. tagging billing/observability for side effects (billingHint key might affect downstream router logic).

customer-acme: thanks for the fast response. we appreciate the update. :thumbsup:

maria (support): will post PR link and ETA in this thread. keeping this thread as single source of truth for the customer chat and internal decisioning.
